A.depoimento: King A launches a double attack! My spearmen take Santarem, archers take Evora. Capital remains defended, and we build more troops for the next campaign.
A.plano: Attack the two neutral villages to expand. Send spearman to Santarem (counter knight) and archers to Evora (counter spearman). Keep a garrison at home and build more spearman. After capture, we will have 3 villages and can explore further.

A.depoimento: I am mobilizing my forces from the capital to the front lines. I have built knights in Lisboa and spearmen in Santarem and Evora to strengthen my army. I am sending my troops to reinforce Santarem and Evora, ready to strike the neutral villages next turn.
A.plano: Reinforce Santarem and Evora with troops from Lisboa. Build 2 knights in Lisboa, 2 spearmen in Santarem, and 2 spearmen in Evora. Next turn, use the reinforced armies to capture Coimbra and Faro.

A.depoimento: I ordered the assault on the neutral villages of Coimbra and Faro, sending seasoned troops from Santarem and Evora. At home, I ordered the construction of more spearman to bolster our growing army. The king's expansion begins now!
A.plano: Capture Coimbra from Santarem and Faro from Evora. Build 2 spearmen in each of my three villages to reinforce them. Next turn, assess the newly discovered villages and continue expanding towards the enemy capital.

B.depoimento: I have split my forces to take both Tarragona and Girona simultaneously, securing my flanks and expanding my territory before the neutrals can reinforce.
B.plano: Conquer Tarragona and Girona this turn to secure my borders and expand. Next, push towards Zaragoza and Huesca to gather more forces and eventually surround the enemy capital.

A.depoimento: My armies have struck at the neutral villages of Badajoz and Porto, leading with spearmen to counter their knights. I have also shifted troops from Lisbon to Santarem, from Santarem to Coimbra, and from Evora to Faro to strengthen my core positions. My forges are producing spearmen in three villages to swell my ranks for the next advance.
A.plano: Conquer Badajoz and Porto with spearman-led forces to exploit the counter bonus. Reinforce Santarem from Lisbon, Santarem to Coimbra, and Evora to Faro to consolidate my territory. Build 2 spearmen in Lisbon, Santarem, and Evora. Next turn, assess the newly revealed villages (Toledo, Vigo) and push toward Salamanca and Sevilha.

B.depoimento: Ordered the assault on Castellon with my Tarragona forces. Sent reinforcements from Barcelona to Tarragona to secure the frontier and prepare for the next push into Zaragoza. Built 3 spearmen in Barcelona to bolster my spearhead against the northern knights.
B.plano: Conquer Castellon this turn using Tarragona's full garrison. Reinforce Tarragona with Barcelona's archers and knights. Build 3 spearmen in Barcelona for next turn's push towards Zaragoza and Huesca. Keep Girona's troops on hold for now.

A.depoimento: I have strengthened my armies, building knights in the south and spearman in Coimbra and Faro. I am moving spearman from Faro and Santarem to Badajoz, and knights to the front, to prepare for attacks on the neutral villages of Sevilha and Salamanca. My forces are on the march.
A.plano: Build knights in Lisboa, Santarem, Evora; spearman in Coimbra, Faro. Send spearman from Faro and Santarem to Badajoz to gather 7 spearman for Sevilha. Send 1 knight from Santarem to Badajoz for Salamanca. Send spearman from Coimbra to Porto for Vigo. Next turn: attack Salamanca with 2 knights from Badajoz, attack Sevilha with 7 spearman from Badajoz, build 2 spearman in Porto for Vigo. Garrison captured villages promptly.

A.depoimento: We launched a multi-pronged assault on the neutral villages. Knights from Badajoz and Santarem are moving to secure Salamanca and prepare for Toledo. Spearman from Badajoz are marching on Sevilha, while reinforcements from Faro and Coimbra are moving to Badajoz and Porto respectively to maintain our offensive momentum and defend our core territories.
A.plano: Attack Salamanca with 2 knights from Badajoz. Attack Sevilha with 7 spearman from Badajoz. Send 4 spearman from Faro to Badajoz for future defense/reinforcements. Send 2 knights from Santarem to Badajoz for Toledo attack. Send 2 spearman from Coimbra to Porto to gather 8 spearman for Vigo. Build 2 spearman in all villages to replenish losses and prepare for next expansions. Next turn: send 8 spearman from Porto to Vigo, send 2 knights from Badajoz to Toledo, build more troops.

B.depoimento: This turn, we strike at Huesca and Valencia with our available forces, aiming to expand our territory. Meanwhile, we reinforce Tarragona with spearman from Barcelona and build new troops to prepare for the next battles against Zaragoza and Teruel.
B.plano: We launch a two-pronged attack: Girona's forces take Huesca, while Castellon's army assaults Valencia. We build spearman at Tarragona and Girona to replenish and prepare for the next push. Barcelona sends its spearman to Tarragona to reinforce for the attack on Zaragoza next turn. We also send Tarragona's archers and knights to Castellon to build up forces for the assault on Teruel. Our goal is to secure these four neutral villages, then expand west towards Madrid and the enemy capital.

A.depoimento: The great offensive is underway! Our spearmen are descending on Sevilha, our knights are striking Toledo, and the Porto host is assault Vigo. Every available sword is being sent to the border to secure our gains and prepare for the march further into enemy territory. We are building 2 spearmen in every village to ensure our ranks remain full.
A.plano: Our forces are converging on the neutral villages. The 7 spearmen already marching will take Sevilha, 2 knights will take Toledo, and 10 spearmen will take Vigo. We are shuttling all available troops from the safe rear (Lisboa, Santarem, Evora, Coimbra) to the front lines (Badajoz, Faro, Porto) to prepare for the next wave of expansion into the unexplored east. We build 2 spearmen everywhere possible to maintain our momentum.

B.depoimento: Our forces move on all fronts! Tarragona's spearman horde strikes at Zaragoza, while Castellon's mighty army assaults Teruel. Girona and Valencia send reinforcements to secure our new lands. We build spearman everywhere to keep the pressure on our enemies. The conquest of Spain continues!
B.plano: We launch a two-pronged attack: Tarragona's spearman assault Zaragoza, while Castellon's mixed force takes Teruel. Girona's spearman reinforce Huesca, and Valencia's troops reinforce Teruel after its capture. Barcelona's knights march to Tarragona for a rapid response force. We build spearman across all capable villages to replenish our ranks and prepare for the push into Madrid and the unexplored west.

B.depoimento: We are consolidating our forces for the push into Madrid. Troops from Tarragona and Huesca march to Zaragoza to form a strike force, while our builders work overtime to equip our villages. The assault on Teruel is underway and expected to succeed.
B.plano: Consolidate our eastern holdings and prepare for the assault on Madrid. We are moving troops from Tarragona and Huesca to Zaragoza to form a powerful strike force. We are building spearman and knights across all capable villages to replenish our ranks and prepare for the push into the unexplored west after securing the neutral villages.

A.depoimento: I am reinforcing my eastern border at Toledo by moving spearmen from Badajoz, while sending my existing archers to Sevilha to prepare for the conquest of Cordoba. I have ordered the construction of archers across my realm to field a powerful army.
A.plano: Reinforce Toledo with spearman from Badajoz to defend against enemy counterattack. Send archers from Faro to Sevilha to prepare for the attack on Cordoba. Build archers in all villages to build up a large ranged army for future campaigns. Next turn, gather archers at Sevilha and attack Cordoba.

B.depoimento: We order the assault on Madrid and Pamplona, using our forces to expand our territory. We also send reinforcements to secure our borders and build new troops for the coming battles. The campaign to hold 18 villages has begun.
B.plano: We are launching a double attack from Zaragoza to capture Madrid and Pamplona. We send knights and an archer to Madrid to counter their archers, and spearmen to Pamplona to counter their knights. We reinforce Zaragoza with troops from Tarragona and Girona, and send Barcelona's spearmen to Teruel to strengthen our border against the enemy. We also send Castellon's spearmen to Valencia to prepare for the attack on Murcia. We build a mix of spearmen and knights at all our villages to grow our army for further expansion.

A.depoimento: King A orders the armies to strike! Toledo's finest march on Madrid, while Badajoz, Porto, Coimbra, and others rush to reinforce Salamanca. The trap is set. We will crush King B's forces and reclaim our lands. The south gathers its strength to feed the northern blade. To war!
A.plano: This turn, we launch our main attack on Madrid [12] using Toledo's full army. We reinforce Salamanca [7] with troops from Badajoz, Porto, and Coimbra to secure the border and prepare for the next push into enemy territory. We also start moving southern reserves (Faro, Sevilha, Vigo) toward the northern front to sustain the offensive. We must capture Madrid and hold the line. Next turn, we will assess the situation in Madrid and plan the advance toward Zaragoza or Burgos.

B.depoimento: This turn we launch a coordinated assault: Valencia takes Murcia, Madrid takes Salamanca, and we send follow-up forces to Pamplona. Reinforcements flow from the rear to the front: Huesca, Tarragona, and Girona reinforce Zaragoza; Barcelona sends troops to Teruel; Castellon reinforces Valencia. All villages produce spearmen to grow our army. The campaign is expanding on all fronts.
B.plano: Attack Murcia (Valencia) and Salamanca (Madrid) this turn. Send follow-up knights to Pamplona to secure it after the 9 spearmen. Reinforce Zaragoza from Huesca/Tarragona/Girona, and send Barcelona to Teruel for the Toledo assault. Castellon reinforces Valencia. All villages build spearmen. Next: capture Pamplona, Burgos, then Toledo; expand to reach 18 villages.

A.depoimento: Our forces are converging on the enemy's weak points. Madrid will fall to our Toledo vanguard, and Cordoba will be swift taken by our elite archers and knights. We are busily moving our southern reserves to the front, reinforcing our border castles and preparing the next strike. The enemy is on the back foot, and we will not stop until we hold the dominion we need.
A.plano: This turn we focus on capturing Madrid and Cordoba. Our army from Toledo takes Madrid, while a fast archer/knight force from Badajoz captures Cordoba. We are moving southern troops North: Santarem and Sevilha send reinforcements to Badajoz, Porto sends troops to Vigo to prepare for the assault on Burgos. We also reinforce Toledo and Salamanca to secure the border. Next turn, after Madrid and Cordoba fall, we will have 13 villages. We will then push on Burgos and assess the enemy's strength in Teruel. We must keep building troops and maintain the offensive.

A.depoimento: Our armies are on the move! We have launched a major offensive from Vigo to capture the neutral village of Burgos, opening the path north. At the same time, we are shoring up our defenses: Salamanca is sending reinforcements to Madrid, Badajoz is bolstering Toledo, and we are preparing the assault on Murcia by reinforcing Cordoba. We are building troops across our empire to ensure we have the strength to push into enemy territory and secure our dominance!
A.plano: This turn we focus on capturing Burgos to expand north and reinforcing our border villages against enemy counterattacks. We sent our full Vigo garrison to take Burgos, while Salamanca reinforces Madrid, Badajoz reinforces Toledo, and Sevilha/Toledo reinforce Cordoba for the push on Murcia. We must keep building troops to sustain these offensives and watch for enemy movements on our borders. Do not leave Madrid or Toledo under-defended.

B.depoimento: This turn, we struck hard on multiple fronts! From Zaragoza, our elite forces marched on Madrid and crushed the enemy garrison, reclaiming the city. In the north, Pamplona's army overwhelmed the neutral forces at Burgos, expanding our territory. While our main armies advanced, we quietly reinforced Teruel with troops from Valencia and Castellon, setting up a devastating blow against Toledo next turn. We also secured our rear by sending reinforcements to Zaragoza. The Kingdom of B is on the rise!
B.plano: Our campaign focuses on a multi-front offensive to expand our territory and secure key victories. This turn, we launch decisive attacks on Madrid from Zaragoza and the neutral Burgos from Pamplona, aiming to conquer both and increase our village count to 12. Simultaneously, we reinforce our eastern front by sending troops from Valencia and Castellon to Teruel, preparing for a massive push on Toledo next turn. We also move troops from Huesca and Tarragona to Zaragoza to secure our capital's border after the Madrid assault. We will continue building knights in all major villages to maintain our

A.depoimento: Ordered a triple attack on Pamplona, Murcia, and Zaragoza. My armies are marching to overwhelm the enemy's defenses and expand my territory to 17 villages.
A.plano: Capture Pamplona, Murcia, and Zaragoza to reach 17 villages. Next turn, inspect newly visible Valencia, Huesca, and Tarragona, then capture one to hit 18. Focus on archer production to maintain offensive pressure.

B.depoimento: Reinforcing the front lines with all available knights and spearmen. Building troops in every village to fuel the campaign. Preparing for a massive push on Madrid and Toledo next turn.
B.plano: Concentrate all forces on the Zaragoza and Teruel fronts. This turn, build maximum knights in all villages and march all available troops to the front lines. Next turn, launch a coordinated assault on Madrid from Zaragoza and Toledo from Teruel. After capturing these, push west to Salamanca and south to Cordoba, aiming to secure 18 villages for the win.

A.depoimento: I am launching a targeted offensive against the enemy's weakest outposts: Valencia and Huesca. With these captures, I will hold 18 villages and secure the 75% control needed for victory. My spearmen are marching now, and I am reinforcing Madrid to guard against counterattacks. The enemy capital may be formidable, but I will win by expanding my territory steadily.
A.plano: Focus on capturing the weakly defended enemy villages Valencia [16] and Huesca [20] to reach the 18-village threshold. Send spearmen from Murcia and Pamplona, as spearmen counter the knights garrisoning those villages. Reinforce Madrid from Salamanca to protect the border against Zaragoza. Build additional spearmen in border villages to replenish losses and maintain defensive strength. Avoid attacking heavily fortified targets like Teruel and Zaragoza for now. Monitor for enemy army movements and be ready to defend.

B.depoimento: Order the armies of Zaragoza and Teruel to strike Madrid and Toledo. The enemy's defenses at Madrid are weak, and Toledo, though heavily fortified, must fall to my superior numbers. Simultaneously, knights from Girona and Castellon march to Huesca and Valencia to strengthen our borders. All villages are set to produce knights, ensuring our cavalry remains dominant. The road to Lisbon begins with these victories!
B.plano: My campaign focuses on breaking the enemy's western and central fronts simultaneously. This turn, I launch a decisive double strike: Zaragoza captures Madrid, opening the path to the west, while Teruel destroys Toledo, securing my southern flank and opening the route to Badajoz and Cordoba. In parallel, I reinforce my border villages of Valencia and Huesca to deter enemy counter-attacks, and continue building knights in all my villages to maintain momentum. Next turn, I will push west from Madrid towards Salamanca and Burgos, and south from Toledo to clear the remaining enemy villages.

A.depoimento: I am launching a coordinated attack on Valencia and Zaragoza. My troops in Murcia are striking Valencia, while archers from Salamanca march on Zaragoza. The 8 spearmen heading to Huesca are a sacrifice to weaken the enemy garrison. I am reinforcing my border villages to prevent enemy counterattacks and building spearmen to replenish my forces.
A.plano: Focus on capturing Valencia and Zaragoza to reach the 18-village threshold. Send all available troops from Murcia to Valencia. Send archers from Salamanca to Zaragoza to counter the enemy spearmen. Reinforce border villages Cordoba and Pamplona with troops from Sevilha and by building spearmen. Accept the loss of the 8 spearmen marching to Huesca as they cannot win alone.

A.depoimento: I am ordering the garrison of Valencia to attack Teruel, while sending the Murcia spearmen to reinforce Valencia. My border villages are being fortified with new spearmen and knights to prepare for enemy counterattacks. The archers marching to Zaragoza are expected to capture it. Capturing Teruel and Zaragoza will bring me to 18 villages, putting me on the path to victory.
A.plano: Focus on capturing [13] Teruel and [17] Zaragoza next turn to reach 18 villages. Send troops from [16] Valencia to [13] Teruel, and reinforce [16] Valencia with spearmen from [15] Murcia. Build spearmen in border villages [19] Pamplona, [11] Cordoba, and [16] Valencia. The 12 archers marching to [17] Zaragoza should capture it. Do not engage [8] Toledo.

B.depoimento: I am moving my knight reserves to the northern front to crush the enemy's weak points. Tarragona's knights march to Castellon, Barcelona reinforces Tarragona, while Huesca and Girona send knights to Zaragoza to secure it against the enemy's approaching army. All northern villages are building knights to swell our ranks.
B.plano: Focus on the northern front to capture Valencia and Pamplona. Reinforce Castellon and Zaragoza with knights from Tarragona, Barcelona, Huesca, Girona, and Teruel. Build knights in all northern villages to maintain momentum. Next turn, attack Valencia with the gathered knights. Hold Zaragoza against the incoming enemy army.

A.depoimento: This turn I launched a strong assault on Zaragoza from Madrid, reinforced Madrid with troops from Salamanca and Burgos, and sent a follow-up force from Pamplona. I built spearman in all my villages to rebuild my army. My goal is to capture Zaragoza and hold it to reach 18 villages.
A.plano: Zaragoza should be captured next turn. Immediately send reinforcements from Madrid to Zaragoza and from interior villages to Madrid to hold the line. Continue building spearman. Watch for enemy counterattacks from Huesca or Tarragona. Do not attack Toledo yet.

B.depoimento: I have ordered a simultaneous assault on Valencia and Teruel with my elite knights, while funneling every available reinforcement into Zaragoza to secure our northern front. This bold strike aims to shatter the enemy's defenses and expand our territory.
B.plano: Launch a decisive double attack on Valencia and Teruel with knights to secure new territories. Simultaneously, funnel all available knights from the rear into Zaragoza to create an unbreakable defensive bulwark. Build knights and spearmen across all villages to replenish losses and maintain momentum for the next phase of the campaign.

B.depoimento: Turn 23 sees the consolidation of my newly conquered territories, Valencia and Teruel. I am launching a two-pronged attack: Valencia's knights are sent to take Murcia, while Teruel's knights aim to capture the strategic hub of Zaragoza. Simultaneously, I am reinforcing Tarragona with spearmen from Barcelona and Castellon to defend against any enemy counter-offensives. My builds are focused on producing knights and spearmen to sustain my army's strength.
B.plano: Focus on expanding the southern and central fronts. Send knights from Valencia to conquer Murcia, and from Teruel to conquer Zaragoza, the enemy hub. Reinforce Tarragona with spearmen from Barcelona and Castellon to secure the northern flank. Build knights and spearmen across all villages to maintain momentum and prepare for the next push towards Madrid and Cordoba.

A.depoimento: Our armies have set out to crush the enemy's weak points: Teruel, Huesca, and Murcia. With spearman leading the charge and archers in support, we expect to overwhelm the sparse enemy garrisons and claim these lands. We have also reinforced Pamplona to ensure our northern flank remains secure, while our villages produce spearman to sustain our momentum.
A.plano: We are attacking Teruel, Huesca, and Murcia to conquer three enemy villages and reach the 18-village threshold. We are reinforcing Pamplona from Burgos to secure our northern border. We are building spearman in all 15 villages to replenish our forces and grow our army for the next phase of the campaign.

B.depoimento: Ordered the conquest of Pamplona with knights from Huesca. Reinforced Tarragona and Huesca with spearmen and knights from rear villages. Built 15 archers across all villages to prepare for the next major push, focusing on countering the enemy's spearman garrisons.
B.plano: Conquer Pamplona with knights from Huesca to expand the northern flank. Reinforce Tarragona with spearmen from Barcelona and Castellon, and Huesca with troops from Girona, to prepare for the push on Zaragoza. On the southern front, build archers in Murcia, Valencia, and Toledo, and reinforce them with knights from Valencia and Teruel. Focus on archer production to counter the enemy's spearman-heavy garrisons, preparing for the assault on Cordoba.

A.depoimento: We have successfully conquered Murcia, bringing our total to 16 villages. With the victory threshold of 18 villages in sight, we are launching a coordinated double offensive: sending all of Murcia's troops to attack Valencia, while our first wave to Teruel arrives tomorrow. To ensure we have the manpower for the next phase, we are building 2 spearman in every single village and concentrating our northern reserves into Zaragoza to prepare for the push into the enemy heartland.
A.plano: We are focusing on conquering Teruel and Valencia to reach the 18-village victory threshold. Our first wave to Teruel arrives tomorrow, and we are sending a second wave from Zaragoza. We are sending all of Murcia's troops to attack Valencia. To prepare for the northern campaign, we are moving all available troops from Pamplona, Madrid, and Burgos to Zaragoza to create a massive strike force. We are building 2 spearman in every village to replenish our losses and grow our army.

A.depoimento: This turn, we focused on reinforcing our borders to secure our 18 villages. We moved troops to Teruel, Valencia, Zaragoza, Pamplona, Cordoba, Madrid, and Badajoz to strengthen their defenses. We also built spearman in all our villages to replenish our ranks and ensure we maintain our hold on the map.
A.plano: We are reinforcing our border villages to ensure we hold 18 villages for 2 consecutive turns and win. We sent spearman from Santarem to Badajoz, Salamanca to Madrid, Madrid to Zaragoza, Zaragoza to Teruel, Murcia to Valencia, Burgos to Pamplona, and Sevilha to Cordoba. We built 2 spearman in every village (4 in Teruel and Valencia) to grow our army. Next turn, we will check if we have held 18 villages and prepare for any enemy counter-attacks.

A.depoimento: Turn 27: I order a full assault on Castellon, sending all of Valencia's garrison to crush the tiny enemy resistance there. To secure the north, I march spearman from Zaragoza and Burgos to Pamplona, shoring up its defenses. Across the empire, every village works to forge two more spearmen, swelling our ranks as we move closer to total victory!
A.plano: We are attacking the weak enemy village of Castellon [18] with all troops from Valencia [16] to conquer it and increase our village count to 19. We are also reinforcing Pamplona [19] with 10 spearman from Zaragoza [17] and 2 from Burgos [14] to secure our northern border. We built 2 spearman in all 18 villages to grow our army. Next turn, we will check if Castellon is conquered and reinforce our positions.

B.depoimento: We are reinforcing our fronts. Tarragona's troops march to Castellon to prepare for the assault on Valencia, while Girona's archers head to Huesca to bolster the attack on Pamplona. Our builders are working overtime, producing knights and spearmen across the realm to swell our ranks.
B.plano: Concentrate forces on the southern front (Castellon) to capture Valencia, and the northern front (Huesca) to capture Pamplona. Move troops from Tarragona to Castellon, and Girona to Huesca. Build knights and spearmen in all villages to grow the army. Next turn, attack Valencia from Castellon and Pamplona from Huesca.
